items.prompt: Point A is at (3, 5). It moves 4 squares right and 2 squares down. What are the coordinates of its new position?
hints: The first number tells how far across.
Right adds to the first number. Down takes away from the second.
items.explanation: Right 4 makes x = 3 + 4 = 7. Down 2 makes y = 5 - 2 = 3. The new position is (7, 3).

options.why: Moving down makes the y-coordinate smaller.
The first number is right and left, and the second is up and down.
Moving right adds to the x-coordinate.

items.prompt: ABCD is a rectangle. A is at (1, 1), B is at (5, 1) and C is at (5, 4). What are the coordinates of D?
hints: Sketch the three points on a grid.
D is above A and next to C.
D has the same x as A and the same y as C.
items.explanation: In a rectangle, D has the same x-coordinate as A (1) and the same y-coordinate as C (4). So D is (1, 4).

options.why: D is above A, so the y-coordinate is not 1.
D must line up with A and C.
The sides of this rectangle go straight across and straight up and down.
